[[Rull Browbeater]] is an [[Ettin]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Perdition Rock]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ring of Fire Island Chain]]
** {{NPC location|Perdition Rock}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Healing Hands}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Purge Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Restore Life}}
* {{skill icon|Signet of Devotion}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Igneous Hump]]

== Notes ==
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible [[spawn]] locations, which he shares with [[Nayl Klaw Tuthan]] and [[Rwek Khawl Mawl]].
* Does not always spawn, if he is not at the four locations above, [[zone|rezone]] and try again.
* Immediately upon zoning into Perdition Rock, you can turn left and check one of his spawn locations without having to fight anything. You can keep rezoning until he does show up.  
* In [[hard mode]], without some form of dedicated [[interrupt]], this boss can be very difficult to defeat, especially with the [[Hydra]]s that it is grouped with. A [[Wurm]] may also spawn in this area and make the battle even harder.
* This boss attacks with a [[hammer]], even though its [[profession]] is [[Monk]].
